notes: Fixes a lost-update race condition in the 24/7 service's shared state file, introduced by v1.0.8's new concurrent per-page servicing: several pages'/posts' processing threads writing dashboard status and daily-quota counters at the same moment could silently clobber each other's update, undercounting the daily limit and occasionally showing stale dashboard status. All state-file writes are now serialized under one lock.
